W.name: Soul Ignition
W.title: Template:Data Locke/Soul Ignition
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Soul Ignition|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Locke
|skill        = W
|icon         = Locke Soul Ignition.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' ignites his soul for 6 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{as|{{pplevel|40 to 70|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}} and {{as|40% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}, with the latter decaying to {{as|20%|ms}} over 1 second after {{fd|1.5}} seconds have elapsed.
|description2 = Additionally, during the effect he stores an amount of [[grey health]] on his [[health bar]] equal to 100% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes from enemy {{tip|champions}}, up to a cap, plus the total amount of health expended from ''Soul Ignition's'' {{tip|health resource|health cost}}. '''Locke''' additionally stores up to {{pplevel|40 to 200}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} grey health for himself, based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}} and ''Soul Ignition's'' elapsed duration. The {{as|'''missing''' health}} portion of this additional grey health stored reaches its maximum when his {{as|'''current''' health}} is at or below {{pplevel|150 to 450|color=health}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}.
|leveling2     = {{st|Damage taken grey health cap|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
|icon3        = Locke Soul Ignition 2.png
|description3 = After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, ''Soul Ignition'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
|description4 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Locke''' ends ''Soul Ignition'' and consumes his [[grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.
|description5 = ''Soul Ignition's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|18 to 14}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 70}}
|costtype     = Mana ({{as|+ {{fd|0.5}}% '''current''' health}} per {{fd|0.25}} seconds)
|targeting    = Auto
|cast time    = none
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* Health cost totals approximately {{as|{{fd|11.335}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} when cast at full health over the full duration.
* The health cost updates dynamically with '''Locke's''' {{as|'''current''' health}}, costing less the lower his remaining health is. It is not based on his {{as|'''current''' health}} at the time of cast.
* If '''Locke's''' {{as|'''total maximum''' health}} is less than or equal to a value of {{pplevel|150 to 450}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}, he will not store any additional grey health based on his {{as|'''missing''' health}} and ''Soul Ignition's'' duration.{{bug}}
** This may occur in situations where '''Locke''' has very high amounts of {{as|ability power}} while not having as much {{as|'''total''' health}}.
* ''Soul Ignition's'' recast does not interrupt {{si|Recall}}.
|blurbicon    = Locke Soul Ignition.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Locke}} ignites his soul for a few seconds, gaining {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' move speed}}}}. He also stores {{as|grey health|buzzword4}} equal to the damage taken from champions, and an additional amount based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}} and ''Soul Ignition's'' elapsed duration.
|blurb2       = ''Soul Ignition'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. The recast can be used while under {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Locke''' ends ''Soul Ignition'' and consumes his {{as|grey health|buzzword4}} to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.
|blurb4       = ''Soul Ignition'' incurs a continual {{as|health cost}} over the duration, which is then compensated in the heal.
}}

E.name: Ashen Pursuit
E.title: Template:Data Locke/Ashen Pursuit
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Ashen Pursuit|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Locke
|skill        = E
|icon         = Locke Ashen Pursuit.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' {{tip|blinks}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival.
|leveling     = {{st|Blink Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 80}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
|icon2        = Locke Ashen Pursuit 2.png
|description2 = After a {{fd|0.1}}-second delay, he empowers his next {{tip|basic attack|icononly=true}} {{tt|attack command|Technically not a basic attack, see notes. This dash ability is performed as soon as his declared attack target is within attack range (normally 400 units).}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|range|275 '''bonus''' range}} and cause him to {{tip|dash}} in the target's direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies along the way, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target hit.
|leveling2    = {{st|Dash Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|40+40 to 80+120}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+40}}% AP)}}}}
|description3 = Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} resets the {{sti|cooldown}}.
|description4 = '''''Locke''' {{tt|cannot perform|See notes}} the dash while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.''
|target range = {{tt|375|Maximum blink range (estimated), has no minimum blink range}}
|range        = <!--{{dv|{{tt|X|Minimum dash distance}}|{{tt|X|Maximum dash distance}}}}-->
|width        = <!--{{tt|150?|Dash damage width}}-->
|cast time    = {{fd|0.5}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.175}}
|cooldown     = 10
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = {{ap|30 to 70}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Location
|effectradius = 100
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = special
|parry        = special
|projectile   = false
|grounded     = true
|knockdown    = true
|notes        = 
* ''Ashen Pursuit's'' damage types:
** The blink deals {{tip|area damage}}.
** The dash deals {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets.
* ''Ashen's Pursuit's'' dash:
** Does not count as a basic attack and will not trigger any basic attack-specific interactions (e.g. {{tip|on-attack}} effects, basic attack timer, etc) unless it is special cased to do so.
*** It is special cased to not deal damage to the primary target if '''Locke''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}} or if the target was under the effect of a spell that granted them {{tip|dodge|dodging}} or {{tip|block|blocking}} effects.
<!--Doesn't actually empower his auto, it's just a dash spell that gets cast when he right clicks somebody within his auto range. Attack timer doesn't go on cooldown either.-->
** Travels a fixed distance towards the target except in cases where '''Locke''' would dash through the target and beyond his attack range. If such cases would occur, it will instead dash him to 125 units beyond their location (within attack range of the target).
** Is disabled if '''Locke''' is affected by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} crowd control or if he is {{tip|ground|grounded}}.
*** He loses the '''bonus''' attack range and is also completely unable to perform the empowered attack. If he can attack a target under this circumstance, he will basic attack them normally without consuming the empowered attack.
*** For the former case, the only exceptions are {{tip|berserk}} and {{tip|taunt}}. These crowd control types will {{tip|forced action|force}} '''Locke''' to perform the dash ability against the source of the disable.
** Can dash through terrain, provided the primary target is on the other side.
*** It will however fail to cast if the target is at the very edge of '''Locke's''' attack range and is over terrain (no terrain grace).{{bug|2}}
** Orders '''Locke''' to attack the primary target at its end.
** Cannot be performed while '''Locke''' is {{tip|disarm|disarmed}}, though he retains the bonus attack range.
* If a champion {{tip|takedown}} is scored while ''Ashen Pursuit'' is active, the ability's cooldown will be reset in addition to allowing '''Locke''' to cast ''Ashen Pursuit'' even while it is already active.
** If cast while the effect is already active, ''Ashen Pursuit's'' duration for the dash attack is refreshed after the blink.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} can block either the blink damage or the dash damage, but not both.
* ''{{ai|Soul Ignition|Locke}}'' can be cast during ''Ashen Pursuit's'' dash.
** Any other ability is queued instead.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Locke Ashen Pursuit.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Locke}} {{tip|blinks}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival.
|blurb2       = He then empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and cause him to {{tip|dash}} in the target's direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies along the way, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target hit.
|blurb3       = Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} resets the {{sti|cooldown}}.
}}

R.name: Purgatory
R.title: Template:Data Locke/Purgatory
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Purgatory|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Locke
|skill        = R
|icon         = Locke Purgatory.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' throws a totem artifact that travels to the target location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. After landing for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, the totem fires latching nails at nearby enemies: dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% decaying over 2 seconds, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second, and marking enemy {{tip|champions}} hit for 5 seconds. Marked enemies are {{tip|execute|executed}} below a portion of their {{as|health}}. Successful executions refresh the mark duration on all affected targets.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 300}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Execute Threshold|{{as|{{ap|10 to 12}}%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per Sealed Champion stack)|buzzword}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
|icon2        = Locke Purgatory 2.png
|description2 = Once all marks expire, and if at least one {{tip|champion}} was executed, the totem seals the souls of all executed champions and drops to the ground both over {{fd|2.25}} seconds. It then lingers for a duration equal to ''Purgatory's'' {{tt|{{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}}|Remaining CD at the time that the totem initialized the sealing process.}}, but for no less than 10 seconds. '''Locke''' can move near the totem to collect it, and for each soul sealed it will both reduce ''Purgatory's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 20% of its '''total''' cooldown and grant him a permanent {{as|Sealed Champion|buzzword}} stack.
|target range = 950<!--1000?-->
|effect radius= 400<!--425?-->
|collisionradius=
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|speed        = 
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 80}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|targeting    = Location
|cast time    = {{fd|0.5}}
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = Magic True
|spelleffects = special
|spellshield  = special
|projectile   = special
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* The totem grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|1.25}} seconds after the landing delay.
** If an enemy champion was marked, it grants sight in the area for 3 seconds instead.
* Applies {{tip|area damage}} with the nail and deals {{tip|raw damage}} to executed targets.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the nail from the totem but not the execute.
* The totem missile can be destroyed by {{tip|projectile|projectile-interception}} effects. The homing nails that the totem fires upon targets cannot be however.
* Champions that take {{tip|death|fatal damage}} from another source (such as by ''Purgatory's'' initial damage) and not by the execute will still count for having their soul sealed away.
* {{tip|Clone|Clones}} can be marked and executed, but cannot have their soul be sealed away.
* Champions in a {{tip|zombie state}} can be marked, but cannot be executed.
* Champions protected by {{tip|invulnerability}} cannot be executed but will count as the execution being successfully triggered against them if they were below the threshold, sealing their soul away.{{bug|2}}
* Champions with a {{tip|minimum health threshold}} will not be executed by any means, even if they are below the execution threshold. The execution may still trigger if the mark lingers after the minimum health threshold effect expires.
* {{tip|Resurrection}} effect interactions:
** {{iis|Guardian Angel}} {{nie|Rebirth}} and {{cai|R|Zilean}} will always prevent the resurrected champion from having their soul sealed away.
** {{cai|I|Zaahen}} will allow the totem to free his soul away when the resurrection is triggered.
** If the resurrection effects of {{cai|I|Anivia}} and {{cai|I|Zac}} trigger from taking lethal damage by ''Purgatory's'' initial damage, they will still count for having their soul sealed away.{{bug|2}}
*** If the execution triggered their resurrection, however, their souls will not be sealed away.
* The totem will remain on the ground no matter how distant '''Locke''' is from it and/or if he {{tip|death|dies}}.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
<!--Blurb-->
|blurbicon    = Locke Purgatory.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Locke}} throws a totem to the target location that fires latching nails at nearby enemies: dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} for a moment, and marking enemy {{tip|champions}} hit for a few seconds. Marked enemies are {{tip|execute|executed}} below a portion of their {{as|health}} based on the amount of {{as|Sealed Champion|buzzword}} stacks.
|blurb2       = Once all marks expire, and if at least one {{tip|champion}} was executed, the totem seals the souls of all executed champions and lingers for a long time. '''Locke''' can move to collect the totem, and for each soul it will both reduce the {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}} and grant a permanent {{as|Sealed Champion|buzzword}} stack.
}}
